meta.name: glowshroom_vale
meta.prompt: A glowing mushroom vale where a strange village has grown between the caps.

programs.brief: A colossal bioluminescent elder mushroom with a towering warped stem, shelf fungal walkways spiraling up the stalk, and an enormous glowing cap with shroomlight and hanging spores.

tokens.terrain: a damp vale cradled between slopes, filled with giant glowing mushroom caps and spore mist
tokens.icons: village dwellings perched under and built between massive glowing mushrooms; rope bridges and timber walkways between the stalks; bioluminescent lanterns along winding paths
